meta.text: Notice the shuffle bytes and stage count readouts too. Now raise the broadcast threshold well above the right table's size and see the strategy switch to broadcast hash join — the shuffle collapses, because one side is simply copied to every executor. Then check the failure case: broadcast a large side by pushing the threshold up on a big table, and read the memory pressure warning. Finally, toggle the broadcast hint on and off to see the physical plan move regardless of size. Try each of those before we move on.
